_comment: THE one place for affiliate links. Swap each partner's `url` for the tracked link once the owner has an affiliate ID (sign-up: Self and Kikoff both via FlexOffers, see `signupUrl`). Until then the links go to the plain product sites with no tracking. `pages` decides where the 'build your credit' slot shows; it is rendered once, by BaseLayout. Added 2026-10-08.
heading: Building credit while you fix the paperwork?
intro: A letter explains your history. Only time and on-time payments change it. Two credit-builder products some people use alongside a dispute or goodwill letter. Both charge a monthly payment or a monthly fee; ApprovalPrep does not.
disclosure: ApprovalPrep is not paid to recommend these and is not a lender or credit repair organization. If we join their referral programs later, we may earn a commission; the price you pay does not change. Not credit advice.

partners.name: Self
partners.blurb: Credit Builder Account. A monthly-fee product: you make monthly payments into a savings-backed loan, reported to the three credit bureaus, and pay Self's fees and interest.

partners.name: Kikoff
partners.blurb: A monthly-fee product: a credit account that charges a monthly fee and reports on-time payments to the credit bureaus.
